note: Our comparison: a style/size comp to a past or current Steeler, in our own words. Not a projection. Top prospects hand-picked by our staff; others matched by position and size to Steelers with 3+ seasons on the roster since 2000 (nflverse rosters, CC-BY 4.0).

Colin Simmons.name: T.J. Watt
Colin Simmons.reason: Explosive get-off and relentless hands; a production-first edge who lives in the backfield.

Jeremiah Smith.name: Plaxico Burress
Jeremiah Smith.reason: Long, fluid outside receiver who turns 50-50 balls into easy catches; more polished at the same age.

Jordan Seaton.name: Alejandro Villanueva
Jordan Seaton.reason: Long-armed left tackle who wins with length and patience in pass protection; more athletic out of the gate.

Trevor Goosby.name: Marcus Gilbert
Trevor Goosby.reason: Huge right-side frame with a strong anchor; a mauler in the run game.

Darian Mensah.name: Kenny Pickett (best case)
Darian Mensah.reason: Timing-and-touch passer who wins from the pocket with anticipation rather than raw arm strength.

Drew Mestemaker.name: Mason Rudolph
Drew Mestemaker.reason: Big-production pocket passer from a wide-open offense; sees the field well, needs to speed up under pressure.

Arch Manning.name: Ben Roethlisberger
Arch Manning.reason: Prototype size with sneaky mobility and a big arm; the tools are there to be a franchise passer.

Yhonzae Pierre.name: Alex Highsmith
Yhonzae Pierre.reason: Twitchy, bendy edge who wins with speed and effort around the corner.

Dante Moore.name: Ben Roethlisberger (early years)
Dante Moore.reason: Big arm that can make every throw; like young Ben, the upside shows up in flashes before the consistency does.

Leonard Moore.name: Ike Taylor
Leonard Moore.reason: Tall, physical press-man corner who erases one side of the field.
